name: databow
description: A command-line tool for querying databases

issues.title: Feature request: Show data type in table output
Support other ADBC methods other than executing statements

latest_release.name: v0.2.0
latest_release.body:
## What's Changed
* docs: remove --pre from dbc install clickhouse by @ianmcook in https://github.com/columnar-tech/databow/pull/25
* docs: add Homebrew installation instructions by @esadek in https://github.com/columnar-tech/databow/pull/28
* feat: infer driver from URI scheme by @esadek in https://github.com/columnar-tech/databow/pull/29
* docs: add chdb example by @esadek in https://github.com/columnar-tech/databow/pull/30
* docs: add presto example by @esadek in https://github.com/columnar-tech/databow/pull/31
* feat: show info on repl startup by @esadek in https://github.com/columnar-tech/databow/pull/27
* chore(deps): upgrade arrow, adbc, comfy-table, reedline by @esadek in https://github.com/columnar-tech/databow/pull/35
* feat: add JSON lines, Arrow IPC stream, and Parquet output formats by @esadek in https://github.com/columnar-tech/databow/pull/26
* docs: fix broken links from tutorial to reference page by @esadek in https://github.com/columnar-tech/databow/pull/42
* feat: add dot commands, result truncation and pager to repl by @esadek in https://github.com/columnar-tech/databow/pull/36
* feat: add support for statement options by @esadek in https://github.com/columnar-tech/databow/pull/40
* docs: add database examples by @esadek in https://github.com/columnar-tech/databow/pull/38


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/columnar-tech/databow/compare/v0.1.2...v0.2.0
